classic.title: Classic
classic.description: The game-night classic: you decide where every roll lands, for 13 rounds.

top-to-bottom.title: Top to bottom
top-to-bottom.description: No choosing, no going back: field by field from top to bottom, with the clock ticking.

blitz.title: Blitz
blitz.description: Six rounds, 30 seconds a turn. Hesitate and you've already lost.

same-dice.title: Same dice
same-dice.description: Everyone gets the same dice. All that counts is who makes more of them.

triple.title: Triple
triple.description: Three sheets, triple the thrill: the second counts double, the third triple.

yatzy.title: Yatzy
yatzy.description: The Scandinavian take: pairs count, straights are strict, the bonus pays 50.

classic-xl.title: Classic XL
classic-xl.description: More sheet, more chances: Two pairs, Even, Odd and Mini join in.

lucky-number.title: Lucky number
lucky-number.description: Each round, luck draws a new number. Hit it exactly for 40 points.

nameProblem.too-short: The name needs at least 2 characters.

not-found.title: No round with this code
not-found.body: Check the code and stay close to the host. Both devices need Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.

full.title: This round is full
full.body: All seats are taken. Ask the host to raise the player limit or free up a seat.

removed.title: You were removed
removed.body: The host took you out of this round. You can’t join it again.

started.title: The game has already started
started.body: New players can’t join once the game has started. Ask the host about the next round.

bluetooth-off.title: Bluetooth is off
bluetooth-off.body: Turn on Bluetooth in your device settings and try again.

location-off.title: Location is off
location-off.body: Turn on location services in your device settings so Nearby Dice can find devices nearby.

denied.title: Access denied
denied.body: Without this permission, Nearby Dice can’t find any rounds. You can grant it in your device settings at any time.

bluetooth-off.title: Bluetooth is off
bluetooth-off.body: Turn on Bluetooth in your device settings and try again.

permission-missing.title: Permission missing
permission-missing.body: Nearby Dice needs access to nearby devices to make the round visible.

location-off.title: Location is off
location-off.body: Turn on location services in your device settings so other players can find your round.

primer.title: Play together nearby
primer.body: Nearby Dice needs Bluetooth and access to devices on your local network to connect your phones directly.

permission.androidLocation: Android also needs the location permission to find devices nearby. Nearby Dice never determines or stores your location.

blocked.title: Permission missing
blocked.body: In your device settings, allow Nearby Dice to access nearby devices and the local network. You’ll then continue here automatically.

bluetoothOff.title: Bluetooth is off
bluetoothOff.body: Turn on Bluetooth in your device settings. You’ll continue automatically when you come back.

locationOff.title: Location is off
locationOff.body: Turn on location services so Android can find devices nearby. You’ll continue automatically when you come back.

unavailable.title: Connection not available
unavailable.body: This device or app version doesn’t support nearby connections. Use the installed Nearby Dice app on a supported phone.

checkFailed.title: Permissions not checked
checkFailed.body: The device settings couldn’t be read. Please try again.

permission.fallbackBody: Check the permissions and device settings to find rounds nearby.
permission.settingsFailed: The settings couldn’t be opened. Open them directly on your phone or try again.

dice.title: Nearby Dice with friends
dice.body: You sit together, and everyone plays on their own phone.

code.title: One code is all it takes
code.body: One player creates the round and shows the code. Everyone else enters it.

home.recentEmpty: No rounds played yet. Your first results will show up here.

newPlayer.title: Who’s playing?
newPlayer.body: Choose a name and a colour so the other players recognise you in the lobby.

resume.title: Interrupted session
resume.body: Round {{round}} of {{total}} with {{others, names}}. The connection to host {{host}} dropped {{since}}.
resume.attempt: Stay close to {{host, possessive}} device. Attempt {{n}} of 3.
resume.successBody: {{host}} confirmed your scores. Play continues in round {{round}}.
resume.failBody: {{host}} is out of range or has ended the session. Your scores stay saved.

discardDialog.title: Discard session?
discardDialog.body: The saved scores from round {{round}} will be lost. You can’t undo this.

profile.help: This is how the other players see you.

resetDialog.title: Reset profile?
resetDialog.body: Your name and colour are deleted. Rounds you’ve already played stay in your stats.

training.title: Training
training.intro: Play solo and try out tactics at your own pace.
training.note: Training rounds don’t count towards wins and stats. They have their own best score.

lobby.codeHint: Other players enter this code under “Join a game”.

startDialog.title: Start the game with {{n}} players?
startDialog.body: After that, the rules are fixed and players can only reconnect, not join as new players.

closeDialog.title: Close lobby?
closeDialog.body: All connected players are disconnected and see that the round has ended.

kickDialog.title: Remove {{name}}?
kickDialog.body: {{name}} is disconnected and can’t join this round again.

lobby.reconnectFailedBody: The connection to the host couldn’t be restored. Stay close to the host and try again.

leaveDialog.title: Leave round?
leaveDialog.body: You can rejoin with the code at any time until the round starts.

join.title: Join a game
join.scanFailed: The search couldn’t start. Check the permissions and try again.
join.successBody: The lobby is waiting for you.

game.diceLocked: Dice locked: these values will be scored
game.leaveHostBody: The game ends for all players. The scores are saved.
game.leaveGuestBody: Your scores stay saved. The host can invite you back later.
game.leaveTrainingBody: This training game won’t be saved.

removeDialog.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeDialog.body: {{name, possessive}} scores are taken out of the standings. You can’t undo this.

game.connectionLostBody: Your scores stay saved. You can keep playing later.

endHostDialog.title: End the round for everyone?
endHostDialog.body: The lobby closes. All players return to the home screen.

endGuestDialog.title: Leave round?
endGuestDialog.body: You’ll miss the rematch. The host can keep playing without you.

resetDialog.title: Reset stats?
resetDialog.body: Wins, best score and recent rounds are deleted. You can’t undo this.
